schema.description:
Post Production Calculator (chapter 2.13). This calculator can be used to calculate the emissions that occur after primary production is complete. It can be used to extend from
      a 'cradle-to-gate' calculation to a 'cradle-to-factory-gate' or 'cradle-to-distribution-gate' calculation.
